fields.label: Operating Mode
fields.description: Disabled: no WMS mutations. Shadow: maintain an isolated physical-bin ledger without ERP stock documents. Draft Handoff: approved TEST workflows may also prepare ERP drafts but never submit them.

fields.label: Pilot Warehouse
fields.description: HYD/Shamshabad for the first controlled pilot. This is not an implicit fallback once multiple warehouses are active.

fields.label: Require Completed Pick Before D2C Pack
fields.description: Opt-in pilot gate. Effective only in Shadow or Draft Handoff mode; Disabled mode always leaves the current D2C pack/dispatch flow unchanged.

fields.label: Scope Note
fields.default: Installing this app never activates warehouse execution. TEST sign-off and an explicit mode change are required.

fields.label: Enable WMS vs Atlas Monitor
fields.description: Opt-in pilot monitor. Every 15 minutes it separates known outbound timing from unexplained quantity variance; it never adjusts stock.
